data.exact_reserve_text: Favourable movements of GBP 0.4 million, (2017: GBP 11.2 million favourable) in the past year's provision for claims outstanding, net of expected reinsurance recoveries, are included in claims incurred, net of reinsurance.
data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a mixed prior year development in 2018. While the gross prior year provision for claims outstanding showed a minor strengthening of GBP 0.002 million, the narrative text describes a net favourable movement (release) of GBP 0.4 million after reinsurance recoveries. The specific causes for this gross strengthening are not detailed, but the net movement is attributed to favourable claims development.

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The gross prior year development figure of +GBP 0.002m (strengthening) is taken from the 'Change in prior year provisions' row in the Technical Provisions note (page 17). This conflicts with the narrative on page 15 which describes 'Favourable movements of GBP 0.4 million... net of expected reinsurance recoveries' (a net release). The gross figure is used as per instructions, but the narrative for causes and summary reflects the net movement as no explanation for the gross strengthening is provided. The claims development triangle on page 16 is significantly distorted by a large RITC transaction (over GBP 1.2bn gross, page 17) and is therefore unreliable for calculating prior year development.
